text: Demo RN policy: an active Virginia RN license must be confirmed against the simulated registry. Candidate claims do not constitute registry verification. Missing or conflicting records require reviewer clarification. All final decisions require a reviewer.

Demo ICU assessment policy: the role requires at least three years of claimed nursing experience and an active Virginia license. Eligible candidates are recommended for an ICU knowledge assessment; the demo does not administer clinical exams.
PRIVATE OTHER TENANT POLICY: this document must never appear in demo-hospital retrieval results.
